spatialBenefitAssessment: The user-controlled ordering is a real addition to the recommended Astra video, whose transcript shows serialized invalidation and refill without concurrent writes. The three possible orderings let a reader investigate why deletion can be defeated. The third dimension itself contributes little: an already-open tunnel represents elapsed time, not a newly discovered spatial relationship. Retain only if the revision makes the independently owned in-flight copy the visible investigative object; architecture and orbit alone do not pass the gate.

findings.issue: The causal objects are tiny inside an elaborate miniature; the source temple, editor furniture, nine cache cubbies and long railway dominate a single-key race.
findings.requestedChange: Replace the temple and furniture with a compact source holder, one cache socket and an exposed suspended read copy. Keep source revision, held revision and cache contents simultaneously readable in the default view. Use short physical revision tokens, not moving prose cards.
findings.evidence: poster.png and all three browser captures: revision numbers occupy a small fraction of the scene; only one of nine cubbies participates.

findings.issue: The alternate-state evidence does not establish the advertised clean-cache/stale-reader inspection state.
findings.requestedChange: Capture a settled publish-while-paused state with source 2, empty cache and held copy 1 visible together, followed by the settled stale fill. Make the caption change at the corresponding logical state, avoiding a previous-state caption during the publish animation.
findings.evidence: in-flight-invalidation.png still shows the reader-paused caption and disabled controls with revision 2 moving; stale-fill.png does show source 2 and cache 1. browser-initial.json is author evidence, not a test run by this reviewer.

findings.issue: The stale result caption offers deletion recovery that the current controls cannot perform.
findings.requestedChange: After publication, repurpose the second action to Delete cached key. Permit the user to invalidate again, then read/fill revision 2, so recovery and stale refill can be compared without resetting the whole example. Qualify expiry as outside the model.
findings.evidence: onPublish returns when S.source===2 and refresh permanently disables btnPublish; final caption says until it expires or is deleted again. Neither subsequent deletion nor expiry is available.

findings.issue: Optional close-ups may lose the simultaneous comparison on which the spatial claim rests.
findings.requestedChange: Keep all three revision locations in a comparison framing, or use a consistent overview restoration after close-up. Verify source pillars and cache framing do not intercept the intended nearest-mesh pick.
findings.evidence: onPick sends source, cache and tunnel to different close-up cameras; provided captures establish only overview geometry, not picking or close-up visibility.

requiredVerification: Coordinator: run publish-read-fill, read-publish-fill and read-fill-publish from Reset and verify the resulting revisions; then verify second-deletion recovery after revision.
Capture settled initial, in-flight invalidated and stale-fill states at 420px and desktop; establish revision legibility without reading the caption.
Verify keyboard controls, nearest-visible-mesh picking, reduced motion, reset during animation and restored framing. No browser interaction or runtime tests were performed by this reviewer.
